newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rennes airport air cargo up 39.0 percent on 1995.
newsitem.headline: Rennes airport air cargo up 39.0 percent on 1995.

text.p: Rennes-St Jacques airport handled 3,377 tonnes of air cargo and trucked airfreight in 1996, an increase of 39.0 percent on 1995 levels, airport authority figures show.
Air cargo volume totalled 3,127 tonnes, up 45.5 percent on 1995 levels.
Rennes sole "all cargo" flight is a nightly service operated by Air Jet and this handled 2,862 tonnes of airfreight in 1996 up 57.0 percent on the previous year.
Trucked airfreight handled at Rennes airport in 1996 totalled 250 tonnes, down 11.0 percent on 1995.
Postal traffic totalled 4,689 tonnes, up 14.2 percent on the previous year. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
